_what: The model on the board (models/mbv2_pose since 2026-10-12): MobileNetV2 backbone, ternary pointwise+stem convs ('pw_stem' region: 33 pointwise + stem = 34 layers), INT8 depthwise convs and INT8 deconvolution head of 32 channels. One training stage on top of sports_r2_w3 (lineage step 2): backbone frozen, head re-trained. Launch with: python -m src.run_recipe configs/probe_tern_dc32.json --stage B [--workdir DIR]
ruler: MPII val 2289 instances, PCKh@0.5, 14 joints, src.evaluate via python -m src.score_ckpt

data_sources.sports: TWN_DATA_ROOT/sports/{annot,images}; Penn Action frames from TWN_SPORTS_IMAGES

B.name: probe_tern_dc32
B.what: backbone of sports_r2_w3 frozen, head (3 deconv + final 1x1, 197,265 params) re-initialised and refitted with the plain ground-truth loss
B.argv_meaning: backbone=ternary pw_stem (default source sports_r2_w3), deconv channels 32, epochs 18

recipe.sampling: MPII + sports, uniform over records (no per-source weights)
